# QML files

Every QML file with the first sentence of its purpose comment (the `//` block above its root object). Grouped by directory; `grep` a word to find where something lives.


## ./

- `shell.qml`: The shell's entrypoint: one top-level piece per surface (shell/), plus _services, which creates the services nothing else would reference.
- `greeter.qml`: The greeter's entrypoint (greetd's login screen; shell.qml is the session's): `qs -p <installed copy>/greeter.qml`, run by scripts/greeter/greeter-session.sh as greetd's user with AXIOM_GREETER=1, which puts ConfigManag…

## components/bar/

- `BarContainer.qml`: Lays out a bar's five widget sections along its main axis in one pass, so they can never overlap: `left`/`right` hug the ends, `center` stays centered on the bar with `leftCenter`/`rightCenter` beside it.
- `BarPanel.qml`: One bar's layer-shell window (shell/Bar makes one per BarManager.bars entry): its screen, layer and exclusive zone, holding the bar's BarContainer.
- `BarWidgetHost.qml`: Hosts one bar module and turns its sizing contract into the numbers the bar layout works with.
- `CornerMerge.qml`: One end of a pill bar that makes way for a pill bar at its corner (BarEnds "pillBar"), with its end pill joined there: that bar's end pill (grown if the bar has none there, BarContainer.setRequest) runs on past this pil…
- `SeparatorMark.qml`: A divider between bar widgets, centred where it's placed: a line across the bar, a dot, a slash or a chevron pointing along it.
- `StandaloneBar.qml`: A bar's BarContainer outside a window of its own, sized from its config (BarPanel draws its bar through it).
- `WidgetBackground.qml`: What a bar widget sits on, in its bar's widget style (widgetStyle, widgetShape): a fill or outline shaped by its caps (BarShapes), or for underline a line along one side.
- `WidgetGroup.qml`: One bar section: a row (or column, on a vertical bar) of BarWidgetHosts that fits itself into `maxExtent` along the main axis by shrinking elastic modules.

## components/bar/widgets/Battery/

- `Battery.qml`: The Battery bar widget: charge level and icon from BatteryManager, colored by charging, low and critical; hidden on machines with no battery.

## components/bar/widgets/Bluetooth/

- `Bluetooth.qml`: Bluetooth status: off / on / connected, optionally with the connected device's name and battery.

## components/bar/widgets/Button/

- `Button.qml`: An icon (and optional label) that runs a built-in shell action or a shell command.

## components/bar/widgets/ClaudeUsage/

- `ClaudeUsage.qml`: Claude plan usage from ClaudeUsageManager, for one or more Claude Code accounts (one per CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, from ClaudeUsageConfig).

## components/bar/widgets/IdleInhibitor/

- `IdleInhibitor.qml`: Caffeine toggle: while on, the compositor (and hypridle) won't treat the session as idle.

## components/bar/widgets/KeyboardLayout/

- `KeyboardLayout.qml`: Active xkb layout of the main keyboard, from KeyboardLayoutManager.

## components/bar/widgets/Media/

- `Media.qml`: The active player's track.

## components/bar/widgets/Microphone/

- `Microphone.qml`: Default input.

## components/bar/widgets/Network/

- `Network.qml`: The primary connection's kind and device.

## components/bar/widgets/NextEvent/

- `NextEvent.qml`: The next event within `lookahead` (or the one under way): "in 10 min · Standup", "now · Standup", "15:00 · Dentist".

## components/bar/widgets/Notifications/

- `Notifications.qml`: The notification bell: a badge with the count, the do-not-disturb icon while it's on.

## components/bar/widgets/Pomodoro/

- `Pomodoro.qml`: The pomodoro timer (PomodoroManager): the time left while a session or break is on, colored by which.

## components/bar/widgets/Privacy/

- `Privacy.qml`: Mic / screen share / camera indicators, derived from active Pipewire links (no polling).

## components/bar/widgets/ScreenRecord/

- `ScreenRecord.qml`: A screen recording in progress (ScreenshotManager): a red dot and the time recorded; a click stops it.

## components/bar/widgets/Separator/

- `Separator.qml`: Layout helper for the bar: a divider (a line, dot, slash or chevron) or plain space, taking exactly `size` px along the bar.

## components/bar/widgets/Stopwatch/

- `Stopwatch.qml`: The one-off timer and the stopwatch (StopwatchManager): the timer's time left while it's set, else the stopwatch's time while it's going.

## components/bar/widgets/SystemStats/

- `SystemStats.qml`: CPU / memory / temperature / GPU / disk readouts from SystemManager, one icon + value segment per enabled metric.

## components/bar/widgets/SystemTray/

- `SystemTray.qml`: The status notifier items, one icon each, in a row (or column, on a vertical bar).

## components/bar/widgets/Tailscale/

- `Tailscale.qml`: The Tailscale bar widget: connected or not, and the tailnet's name, from TailscaleManager (acquired at the widget's interval); a click notifies it.

## components/bar/widgets/Time/

- `Time.qml`: Clock with a date, formatted for the shell's language (General.language: Japanese uses 午前/午後 and 時分秒 / 年月日); a custom `timeFormat` / `dateFormat` (Qt format strings) overrides that.

## components/bar/widgets/Todo/

- `Todo.qml`: How many todos are open (TodoManager).

## components/bar/widgets/Updates/

- `Updates.qml`: Pending package updates from UpdatesManager: repo packages the way this distribution checks them (`checkupdates` on Arch, `dnf check-update` on Fedora; hidden on one UpdatesManager can't check), plus AUR packages via pa…

## components/bar/widgets/Volume/

- `Volume.qml`: Default output volume.

## components/bar/widgets/Weather/

- `Weather.qml`: Current conditions (from WeatherManager, for the Weather settings).

## components/bar/widgets/Window/

- `Window.qml`: The Window bar widget: the focused window's title, elastic in width.

## components/bar/widgets/Workspaces/

- `ActiveCellIndicator.qml`: The active workspace's box (or underline) in a bar switcher's row of cells, drawn once over their boxes and under their labels (the row draws its WorkspaceCells in two layers around it), sliding from cell to cell as the…
- `ActiveStrip.qml`: What a switcher shows after its workspaces on a strip monitor: a divider in the bar's separator style (a line when that's none), then the active workspace's windows in strip order (StripWindows), cross-fading to the nex…
- `CellUnderline.qml`: A bar switcher cell's line in the underline widget style, along the side the bar's widget lines take, filling its parent's length: WorkspaceCell's, and the one ActiveCellIndicator slides
- `StripWindows.qml`: A strip workspace's windows as bar cells (WorkspaceCell), in strip order (CompositorManager.stripWindows), each showing its app icon: the one focused last in the active look, the rest as occupied.
- `WorkspaceCell.qml`: One workspace on the bar, in the bar's widget style (Bar.cellColors): a filled, tinted or outlined box inside the widget's own; on a bar whose widgets have no boxes, its number (or a dot) straight on the bar, under a li…
- `WorkspaceCellRow.qml`: A bar switcher's row (a column on a vertical bar) of WorkspaceCells for workspaces `ids`: the cells' boxes at rest, the active one's sliding over them (ActiveCellIndicator), then their labels and icons over both.
- `WorkspaceGridStrip.qml`: The grid layout's switcher: this monitor's columns × rows workspaces, of which the bar shows the active row (horizontal bar) or column (vertical bar), and the popout the whole grid.
- `WorkspaceStrip.qml`: The standard layout's switcher: workspaces 1..count in a row (horizontal bar) or column (vertical bar), or the ones the compositor has where it makes them itself (CompositorManager.dynamicWorkspaces); click one to go th…
- `Workspaces.qml`: The workspace switcher, laid out as the Workspaces section says: a row of 1..count (WorkspaceStrip), or the active row or column of this monitor's grid with the whole grid as a popout (WorkspaceGridStrip).

## components/bar/widgets/base/

- `AudioLevelWidget.qml`: Base for the Volume and Microphone widgets: a default device's level.
- `BarIconWidget.qml`: Base for icon + label bar modules: the inputs every module gets from BarWidgetHost, orientation from the bar, and the configured colors.
- `BarWidget.qml`: Base for bar widgets that draw their own content (icon + label widgets extend BarIconWidget instead): the inputs every widget gets from BarWidgetHost, and its orientation from the bar.

## components/content/Agenda/

- `Agenda.qml`: What's coming up: the shown calendars' events from today through `days`, grouped by day; a click opens one in the editor, + adds one today.

## components/content/AudioMixer/

- `AudioMixer.qml`: Volume mixer: the default device on top, then an Applications tab (per-app volume, one row per app however many streams it has) and a Devices tab (pick the default, adjust each device).

## components/content/Battery/

- `Battery.qml`: Battery charge, state and time left; "On AC power" on machines without a battery.

## components/content/BluetoothDevices/

- `BluetoothDevices.qml`: Bluetooth menu for the Bluetooth widget: power switch, a Devices tab for paired devices (click to connect / disconnect, forget on hover) and a Discover tab that scans while it's open and pairs + connects on click.

## components/content/Brightness/

- `Brightness.qml`: Screen brightness (BrightnessManager: a laptop panel's backlight, an external monitor over DDC/CI).

## components/content/Calculator/

- `Calculator.qml`: Math, units and currencies through qalc (CalculatorManager), as the launcher's "=" does: the answer shows as you type, Enter (or a click on it) copies it and keeps it in the history below, or beside it in a wide card.

## components/content/Calendar/

- `Calendar.qml`: The month with a dot per calendar on days with events, and the selected day's events under it (beside it in a wide card), which open in the editor; + adds one.

## components/content/Chat/

- `Chat.qml`: The AI chat (ChatManager): an overlay module, and ready to be a bar popout (it's a Panel).

## components/content/Cheatsheet/

- `Cheatsheet.qml`: The keybinds as a read-only cheat sheet (KeybindManager, as Hyprland reports them), sections in as many columns as fit, with a search field of its own (the Keybinds page's filters are left alone).

## components/content/ClaudeUsage/

- `ClaudeUsage.qml`: Claude plan usage per account (from ClaudeUsageManager): the session and weekly limits with their reset times, extra usage and where the week went.

## components/content/ClipboardHistory/

- `ClipboardHistory.qml`: The clipboard history (ClipboardManager, as the launcher's ":" lists it): pinned clips first, then the newest, with a search field.

## components/content/Clock/

- `Clock.qml`: A clock as large as its slot allows, in a `style`: "digital" (the time in one line, the seconds and AM/PM small beside it), "stacked" (the hours over the minutes, the minutes in the accent color) or "analog" (a face wit…

## components/content/ClockCalendar/

- `ClockCalendar.qml`: A clock with the date, plus a month calendar where it fits (beside the clock in wide slots, or where it only fits that way); a wide strip puts the date beside the time.

## components/content/ColorSwatch/

- `ColorSwatch.qml`: properties: { color: base00-base0F (or any name Theme.resolveColor accepts), label }

## components/content/CommandOutput/

- `CommandOutput.qml`: Any shell command's output, run every `interval` seconds while shown (CommandManager: one run for every card and bar button asking for the same command), so a script can be a module with no QML.

## components/content/Disks/

- `Disks.qml`: Usage bar per mount point, under a header where there's room; side by side when they don't fit stacked; compact, the first one's figure. properties: { paths: ["/", "/home"] }

## components/content/EmojiPicker/

- `EmojiPicker.qml`: Emoji to copy (EmojiManager, as the launcher's ";" does): a search field, Unicode's groups as tabs and a grid, most used first until you search or pick a group.

## components/content/Favourites/

- `Favourites.qml`: App launcher buttons.

## components/content/Focus/

- `Focus.qml`: The pomodoro timer, the todo list and today's events (DayPane) in one card: the timer and list side by side with the day when the card is wide, stacked otherwise.

## components/content/Greeting/

- `Greeting.qml`: A line of text, as big as its slot allows: resizing the module resizes the text. {name} is the display name, {user} the user name and {greeting} good morning, afternoon or evening; empty text says hey to the display nam…

## components/content/KeyboardLayout/

- `KeyboardLayout.qml`: The greeter's keyboard layout (x-hosts: greeter only): the active one, and a click switches to the next (the layouts the greeter's compositor has: Input's while its keyboard part is on, else its own).

## components/content/Login/

- `Login.qml`: The greeter's login box (x-hosts: greeter only; x-required, so every greeter layout has one): who logs in and their password.

## components/content/Network/

- `Network.qml`: The primary connection (name, IP, wifi signal), live throughput with a graph, and Tailscale's state when it's installed.

## components/content/NightLightControls/

- `NightLightControls.qml`: The night light (NightLightManager): on or off, how warm (right is warmer) and how dim, and its schedule.

## components/content/Notes/

- `Notes.qml`: Markdown notes from the notes folder (NotesManager), with checklists, rendered but for the paragraph being edited.

## components/content/Notifications/

- `Notifications.qml`: The notification menu (the Notifications widget's popout, or an overlay card): a header with do not disturb and clear all, then one card per app, newest first.

## components/content/NowPlaying/

- `NowPlaying.qml`: The active media player over a blurred copy of its cover: art, track info, a seek bar and controls.

## components/content/Palette/

- `Palette.qml`: The current theme's 16 base colors, each a tile with its key, hex value and up to two of the semantic names that map to it (Theme.roles) beneath: the neutrals in the first row, the accents in the second where it's wide …

## components/content/Password/

- `Password.qml`: The lock screen's password field (x-hosts: lockscreen only; x-required, so every lock screen layout has one).

## components/content/Pomodoro/

- `Pomodoro.qml`: The pomodoro timer (PomodoroManager, PomodoroDial): the Pomodoro widget's popout, or an overlay card, the ring beside the controls when the card is wide and short.

## components/content/Power/

- `Power.qml`: Power buttons for the lock screen and the greeter (x-hosts: those two only): suspend, restart and shut down, nothing else (never log out or unlock).

## components/content/QuickActions/

- `QuickActions.qml`: A grid of action tiles: toggles, session actions and pin, in any mix.

## components/content/ScreenRecord/

- `ScreenRecord.qml`: Screen recording (ScreenshotManager, with wf-recorder): record a region (picked as for a screenshot) or the whole focused screen (the overlay closes first), with the system's sound (with pactl), the microphone or none; …

## components/content/Screenshot/

- `Screenshot.qml`: Screenshots through ScreenshotManager (region, active window or the focused screen), saved to the Screenshots section's folder and copied to the clipboard.

## components/content/Session/

- `Session.qml`: The greeter's session picker (x-hosts: greeter only): which desktop the login starts (Wayland sessions; the user's last one to begin with).

## components/content/Stopwatch/

- `Stopwatch.qml`: The one-off timer and the stopwatch (StopwatchManager), one at a time under a Timer / Stopwatch switch: the Stopwatch widget's popout, or an overlay card.

## components/content/Submenu/

- `MenuSubmenu.qml`: An edge menu's modules in another menu's submenu (SubPopout, loaded as "Submenu/MenuSubmenu" by a Submenu module), on a grid at the card size of the menu it opens from, scaled by this one's moduleScale.
- `Submenu.qml`: A row that opens another edge menu (`menu`) beside the one it's in, in that menu's submenu (EdgePopout.submenu, content/Submenu/MenuSubmenu): on hover, or on a click with openOnHover off.

## components/content/SystemGraphs/

- `SystemGraphs.qml`: Live graphs of system metrics: the current value over a minute of history per metric.

## components/content/SystemTray/

- `SystemTray.qml`: A tray item's menu.

## components/content/ThemePicker/

- `ThemePicker.qml`: The theme list: one tile per theme (a dark/light pair is one theme), in folding groups (built-in, imported, generated), each painted in its own colors, plus the Dark/Light switch that picks the variant and Auto, which s…

## components/content/Todo/

- `Todo.qml`: The todo list (TodoManager): the Todo widget's popout, or an overlay card.

## components/content/TopProcesses/

- `TopProcesses.qml`: The busiest processes, with a kill button on hover.

## components/content/Updates/

- `Updates.qml`: Pending updates, repo and AUR listed separately (from UpdatesManager).

## components/content/VolumeDials/

- `VolumeDials.qml`: Output and microphone volume as two dials: scroll to adjust, click to mute.

## components/content/WallpaperPicker/

- `WallpaperPicker.qml`: Wallpapers from Appearance.wallpaperFolder as a scrolling strip (a grid in taller slots); clicking one sets it and regenerates the themes from it.

## components/content/Weather/

- `Weather.qml`: Current weather, plus the next hours and days where they fit (the days beside it in wide slots), centred as one block; compact, the figure (in a row along a strip).

## components/content/WeatherForecast/

- `WeatherForecast.qml`: Current conditions and a 5-day forecast: the Weather widget's popout, from WeatherManager's source (the widget keeps it acquired).

## components/content/WifiNetworks/

- `WifiNetworks.qml`: Wi-Fi menu for the Network widget: radio switch, the current connection (address and throughput), and the networks in range (scanning while shown).

## components/content/WorkspaceGrid/

- `WorkspaceGrid.qml`: The Workspaces bar widget's popout in the grid layout: the monitor's whole columns × rows grid, with the row (or column, on a vertical bar) the bar shows at full strength.

## components/content/WorkspaceStrips/

- `WorkspaceStrips.qml`: The Workspaces bar widget's popout on a strip monitor: each of the monitor's workspaces with windows (and the active one) as its number cell followed by its windows in strip order (StripWindows), one line per workspace …

## components/content/WorkspacesMap/

- `WorkspacesMap.qml`: Workspaces as tiles with their windows' app icons; click one to go there.

## components/content/WorldClocks/

- `WorldClocks.qml`: The time in several places (TimeZoneManager), here first if `showLocal`.

## components/content/base/

- `Card.qml`: Base for overlay modules (what BaseWidget is for bar modules): the card box filling its slot.
- `CardHeader.qml`: Title row of a TitledCard, with Save and Discard (shown while `dirty`) buttons for whichever service owns the panel's pending edits.
- `Panel.qml`: Content that lays out as a column and can be shown by either host: a bar popout (sized to its content, with the popout's box) or an overlay card (`embedded`: fills the slot, with the card's box).
- `SaveResetActions.qml`: Save and Discard (both shown while `dirty`, or while a box in this window holds typed text: EditsManager.typingField) for whichever service owns a page's pending edits.
- `SlotContext.qml`: What Card and Panel derive from their slot, in one place: its size in grid units (four to a card), shape, whether it's compact, bare, and the padding content lays out within
- `TitledCard.qml`: A titled, scrolling panel card (settings, theme, bar editor panels): header with optional Save/Discard, divider, optional fixed extras (e.g. a tab strip), then the scrolling body that children go into.

## components/content/parts/

- `AudioRow.qml`: One mixer line: icon, title (+ dim subtitle), volume slider, percentage and a mute button (`showMute`).
- `CompactFigure.qml`: What a compact card shows: an icon, one big value and a small label, fitted to the box it fills (fill the card inside its `pad`; a Panel's compactContent is filled for it).
- `DeviceList.qml`: A radio menu's list of devices or networks (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth).
- `DeviceRow.qml`: One device or network in a radio menu (DeviceList): its icon, name and status, a forget button on hover (for a known one; a second click within a few seconds forgets it) and connect / disconnect.
- `EmptyState.qml`: A muted icon over a line of text, for a module with nothing to show ("All caught up", "No paired devices").
- `ExpandButton.qml`: A strip's button growing its detail (`type`, by default the module's own full form) over the grid (Card/Panel.expand); hidden where nothing can show it
- `FigureValue.qml`: A bold value with its unit beside it, on one baseline (StatFigure, CompactFigure)
- `FocusKeeper.qml`: Keeps the keyboard on a field (the lock screen's password, the greeter's login box): whenever focus leaves it, `reclaim` fires on the next tick.
- `ItemRow.qml`: One entry in a module's list (clipboard clips, calculator answers, recordings): an icon or a rounded thumbnail, a title and a muted subtitle, and buttons on the right (children), faint until the row is hovered so showin…
- `KeyCap.qml`: One key (or modifier) of a keybind, drawn as a small keycap: its text, or an icon before it
- `KeyCluster.qml`: A folded direction set's keys in one keycap, spaced (H J K L)
- `KeybindRow.qml`: One action of the keybinds reference, keys first: its key combos (alternatives separated by a slash; a folded direction set as one keycap), its action's icon (a person for the user's own binds), its label, and a warning…
- `KeybindSection.qml`: One section of the keybinds reference as a card: its icon and title, then its rows grouped by modifiers (BindRows.byModifiers), each group under its modifiers, with the keys in one aligned column
- `KeyboardMap.qml`: A US keyboard (KeyMap.rows, then KeyMap.extras), each key coloured and labelled through hooks: the editor's key map of free keys and the keybinds reference's keyboard.
- `KeyboardReference.qml`: The keybinds reference as a keyboard: under the modifiers picked (`mods`), each key shows what it does (KeyMap.labels), coloured by whose bind it is.
- `LoginField.qml`: The greeter's login box: who logs in (a list of the system's users to pick from or type over, or typed only) and the password, with greetd's messages under it.
- `ModifierCap.qml`: A combo's modifiers in one keycap: as glyphs (Super as an icon, ⌃ ⌥ ⇧), or as words with `glyphs` off
- `ModuleHeader.qml`: Icon + title row at the top of a module; children go on the right
- `PasswordField.qml`: The lock screen's password field: what the Password module draws, and LockSurface's own when no Password module shows.
- `PomodoroDial.qml`: The pomodoro timer (PomodoroManager), for the Pomodoro popout and module and the Focus module: a ring with the time left and the phase, a dot per session until the long break, stop / start-pause / skip, and (with `showT…
- `RadioHeader.qml`: A radio menu's title row (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth): the title, a refresh icon spinning while it scans, and the power switch.
- `RateLabel.qml`: A transfer rate with its direction: an arrow and "1.5 MB/s"
- `Sparkline.qml`: A small line graph of `values` (oldest first), filled underneath.
- `StatFigure.qml`: A large value with its unit, and a small label underneath
- `TileGrid.qml`: Places `count` tiles in the grid that gives them the largest size in this item, never stretched past `maxAspect` either way, with a short last row centred.
- `TimeRing.qml`: A countdown ring, for the pomodoro timer (PomodoroDial) and the one-off timer (Stopwatch): how far it's gone around a `size` square, the time in the middle (faded while not `running`) and a short `label` under it.
- `TodoList.qml`: The todo list (TodoManager), for the Todo popout and module and the Focus module: a field to add one, then the items (open, then done with Todo.showCompleted).
- `TrayMenuItem.qml`: One entry of a tray menu (TrayMenuList): a separator, or a label with its check/radio indicator, icon and submenu chevron
- `TrayMenuList.qml`: A tray menu's entries, shared by the tray popout and its submenus.
- `TraySubmenu.qml`: A tray submenu's content, in its popout's submenu (SubPopout, loaded as "parts/TraySubmenu")

## components/content/parts/calendar/

- `DateTimeField.qml`: A date and, unless `allDay`, a time: the date a button that folds a MonthGrid open under it, the time typed ("9", "9:30", "930", "9pm") and shown in the language's format.
- `DayAgenda.qml`: A day's events under its date, with + to add one (when a calendar can take it) and, with `closable`, a back arrow.
- `DayPane.qml`: A day's events (DayAgenda) that turn into the EventEditor for the one clicked, or a new one: what the Calendar popout and module, the Clock & calendar module and the Calendar page show beside their month.
- `EventEditor.qml`: Editing an event: open(draft) loads a CalendarEvents draft (newDraft or draftOf), Save and Delete go through CalendarManager, and `finished` fires once it's done or cancelled.
- `EventRow.qml`: One event in a list: its calendar's color, the title, and when (on `dayKey`) and where.
- `MonthGrid.qml`: A month of days (six weeks from the language's first weekday) with a dot for each calendar that has events on a day, or, with `titles` in cells tall enough, the events themselves.

## components/content/parts/chat/

- `AttachmentChip.qml`: An attached image's thumbnail; `removable` adds a remove button
- `ChatCodeBlock.qml`: A fenced code block in a reply: its language, a copy button and the code in a monospace font.
- `ChatComposer.qml`: Where a message is written: attached images, the text, then a toolbar with the attach buttons, the keys and send (stop while a reply streams).
- `ChatHeader.qml`: The chat's top row: the conversation list toggle, the title, the preset/model chip and a new-chat button, all one height
- `ChatMarkdownText.qml`: Selectable chat text: Markdown prose (Chat.renderMarkdown), or plain text for what the user typed.
- `ChatMessage.qml`: One message: the user's in an accent-tinted bubble on the right, a reply as full-width text (thinking, Markdown prose and code blocks).
- `ChatMessageList.qml`: The conversation, scrolled to the bottom while it streams, unless the user scrolled up (then a "Jump to latest" pill brings it back).
- `ChatThinking.qml`: A reply's thinking, folded under a "Thought for 12s" row.
- `ConversationList.qml`: Saved conversations, newest first under Today / Yesterday / Earlier, with search, rename and delete.
- `ModelPicker.qml`: The conversation's preset, then each provider's models, in one list

## components/content/parts/notes/

- `NoteBlock.qml`: One block of a NoteEditor: a paragraph, or a task line with its checkbox.
- `NoteBrowser.qml`: The notes folder, one level at a time: folders first, then notes.
- `NoteEditor.qml`: Edits one note (a NotesManager document) as NoteMarkdown blocks: plain text, and task lines with checkboxes.

## components/content/parts/notifications/

- `NotificationActions.qml`: A notification's action buttons (all but the default one) as pills, scrolling sideways when they don't fit; emits invoked after running one
- `NotificationAvatar.qml`: A notification's picture: its image (rounded, cropped) when it has one, else the app's icon (the notification's own, else its desktop entry's), else a bell.
- `NotificationGroupDelegate.qml`: One app's notifications as a single card: the app header (icon, name, count, newest time, or dismiss-all while hovered), then its entries.
- `NotificationHeader.qml`: The notification menu's title row: bell, title, count pill, then the do not disturb toggle and clear all
- `NotificationItemDelegate.qml`: One history entry inside a group card: image, summary and body, its time (or a dismiss button while hovered) and, while its notification is live, its actions.
- `NotificationText.qml`: A notification's summary and body (from a Notification or a history entry); clicking runs the live notification's default action.

## components/forms/

- `FieldLinks.qml`: The links under a form row or an inspector (`x-link`: { setting } or { page }, or a list of them), one SettingsLink each, hidden while none of them shows.
- `GreeterSetup.qml`: Setting axiom up as the login screen (GreeterManager), shared by Settings → Login screen (GreeterStatusCard) and the onboarder: what Install changes, Install / Update / Remove (one password prompt each), what's left for…

- `SchemaArrayItem.qml`: itemDelegate for an array-of-objects SchemaField: the item's fields, generated from the array's `items` schema. itemData/itemIndex are assigned imperatively by SchemaObjectArray's Loader after construction, so they must…
- `SchemaComboBox.qml`: i18n: keys from callers and the schema (titles, descriptions, type labels)
- `SchemaField.qml`: i18n: keys from callers and the schema (titles, descriptions, type labels) One row of a schema-driven form: picks the control for the row's schema type (or a list editor for an array of objects), hidden while its `x-sho…
- `SchemaNumberField.qml`: i18n: keys from callers and the schema (titles, descriptions, type labels) An integer setting: a slider with a value box when the range is a comfortable drag (7 to 200 steps), otherwise a compact stepper beside the labe…
- `SchemaObjectArray.qml`: i18n: keys from callers and the schema (titles, descriptions, type labels)

- `SchemaSwitch.qml`: i18n: keys from callers and the schema (titles, descriptions, type labels)
- `SchemaTextField.qml`: i18n: keys from callers and the schema (titles, descriptions, type labels)
- `SettingRows.qml`: Settings by dotted config path ("Apps.terminal"), each a SchemaField row as on the settings page, saved as they change (SettingsManager.commitValues), for pages that apply as the user goes (the onboarder, the Themes pag…

## components/hosts/overlay/

- `ExpandedModule.qml`: A module's detail grown over its grid (ModuleGrid.expand): a card box opening out of the tile or strip that asked for it to the grid less `inset` on every side (the modules stay dimmed beneath it), with a back button ov…
- `ModuleGrid.qml`: A Custom page's, an edge menu's or the lock screen's modules, each in its own place on a grid of quarter cards (GridPlacement).
- `OverlayGrid.qml`: One overlay's card grid, sized to its screen: cards of the card size there times the overlay's Module size, at most two filling the height (OverlayConfig.layoutFor), their content laid out at `unit` and drawn `zoom` (th…
- `OverlayPage.qml`: One page of the overlay: shown when it's the current page, sliding in from the side the navigation came from (`direction`), while the page it replaces slides out the other way and fades.
- `OverlayPageNavigator.qml`: Fixed page navigator for the overlay's pages: arrows at the ends and a tab per page (icon and name), the current one under a sliding accent pill.
- `OverlayPages.qml`: The overlay's pages on one screen: a view per Overlay.views entry, the current one and its neighbours loaded, sliding between them.
- `OverlayPanel.qml`: The overlay's window on one screen (shell/Overlay): opens and closes the sliding box that holds OverlayPages, and closes on Escape or a click outside.
- `OverlaySlot.qml`: Hosts one overlay module in its slot on a grid: loads content/<type>.qml and hands it the entry's `properties` (defaults filled from the schema, as for bar widgets).
- `OverlayView.qml`: Loads one overlay page (views/<type>.qml) for OverlayPages, keeping its grid and viewConfig bound so config edits reach it.
- `ReservedAreaWindow.qml`: A full-screen Overlay-layer window placed inside the border's and bars' reserved area (the overlay, the onboarder).

## components/hosts/popout/

- `AttachedSurface.qml`: The shared "grows out of an edge" shape used by bar popouts, screen-edge popouts and bar pills: a content box joined to the attach edge by two concave fillets, with the bar/border stroke cut open where it joins.
- `AttachedSurfaceCopy.qml`: A copy of an AttachedSurface's shape, its geometry bound live to the source's (sliding with it: its own slide runs with the source's `active`): its fill alone, or with `mirrorStroke`.
- `BarPopouts.qml`: Popout wrapper for bar widgets Handles positioning, animation, and content loading for popouts that emerge from the bar.
- `BlurShape.qml`: A surface's shape, registered with BlurManager for the blur window (shell/BlurBacking) to draw and blur in its place.
- `BorderOpening.qml`: Publishes a stretch of the border's stroke a surface covers (`opening`: { screen, edge, start, end }, screen px along the edge, and the fillets curving into it at its ends, `startFillet`/`endFillet` as SurfaceContext.op…
- `ClosedLatch.qml`: A value that follows `source` only while its host is closed: what changes a popout's window layer or namespace (Hyprland reads a layer rule only as a surface maps), so an open popout never moves or restacks.
- `EdgePlacement.qml`: Where a surface growing out of a screen edge goes along it, and everything that follows from what it meets there, for every host alike: bar popouts, edge popouts (OSDs, floating edge menus, the attached launcher) and do…
- `EdgePopout.qml`: A popout that slides out of a screen edge and joins the screen border (or a bar on that edge) with the same connector + fillets as bar popouts — see AttachedSurface.qml.
- `EdgeSurface.qml`: An AttachedSurface growing out of a screen edge, wired from its EdgePlacement (`geometry`) and, for a host with submenus, its SubmenuHost: whether it's detached, runs straight off its edge, how its ends join or run flus…
- `EdgeTrigger.qml`: A thin hover strip on a screen edge that fires `triggered` once the pointer has rested on it for `hoverDelay`
- `FloatingPopout.qml`: A popout that floats on the screen instead of growing out of an edge (EdgePopout): a plain rounded box in an Overlay-layer window covering the area the bars and border leave free, fading and scaling in.
- `LayerOrigin.qml`: Where a layer-shell `window` is on its screen, as LayerManager works it out from how every window there asks to be laid out (and reports this one's): for surfaces whose fill the blur window draws, the joins in the borde…
- `LayerSlot.qml`: A layer-shell `window` with a fixed place in the stack (a bar, the border, a dock, an integrated edge menu): bind its `visible` to `shown`, and what used to decide it to `wanted`.
- `OutsideShadow.qml`: The shadow (SurfaceShadow) a sibling `target` casts, kept only outside its shape, so none shows through a translucent fill.
- `PillBarJoin.qml`: A surface's end joining a pill bar on a perpendicular screen edge: its end sits on that bar's far stroke, and the bar's pill at this edge's end runs out along the surface (BarContainer.setRequest's endReach: the end pil…
- `PillStretch.qml`: Puts a surface's pill (or island) stretch (EdgeAttach.place's `stretch`) on the bar it stands on (`container`, a BarContainer) under its own owner key, and takes it off again when it clears, the bar changes or this goes.
- `PopoutAnchor.qml`: Drop this into any bar widget that wants to open a bar popout on hover (or, given a `menu`, an edge menu).
- `PopoutClaim.qml`: A popout host's place in PopoutManager: registered while it `wants` to show and has a footprint (rects in screen px), released when it stops.
- `PopoutWrapperBase.qml`: Shared state machine for any "popout wrapper": open/close/reopen queueing, switching in place, and centralized dismiss-on-hover-loss timing.
- `SlideAnimation.qml`: Reusable slide animation container Supports sliding from any direction with optional fade
- `StrokeOpening.qml`: A stretch of a stroke a surface covers, left open there, whatever draws that stroke: every host publishes its openings through this, so one joined the same way opens the same way.
- `SubPopout.qml`: A popout's submenu, one level deep: each popout host has one (BarPopouts.submenu, EdgePopout.submenu), which a PopoutAnchor in its content opens by itself (its window's `popoutHost`), loading content/<name>.qml as a bar…
- `SubmenuHost.qml`: A popout host's submenu (SubPopout, one level deep) and everything the two share, the same for a bar popout and an edge popout: what the submenu meets on the box's side (SubmenuSide), how far it stretches the box past i…
- `SubmenuSide.qml`: What a submenu (SubPopout) meets on the side of its parent's box, the same for a bar popout's and an edge popout's: which side it opens to, whether its ends may run flush to a free end of the side or join the stroke the…
- `SurfaceShadow.qml`: The shell's shadow (the BarStyle section's, as the bars and the border cast it), as a layer effect for a surface with an exposed border: popouts, edge popouts (OSDs, edge menus, the launcher), docks, floating popouts.
- `SwitchStill.qml`: A popout switching to another payload in place (PopoutWrapperBase's canSwitchTo/prepareSwitch: BarPopouts, SubPopout): the content switched away from, as a still the host places where that content was (from `held`), fad…

## components/methods/

- `BarAutoColors.qml`: The colors a bar picks for its widgets' Auto color fields (a schema `x-autoColor` role, left empty).
- `BarEnds.qml`: What each end of a bar meets, where bars on perpendicular edges share a corner (pure).
- `BarLayout.qml`: Pure main-axis layout for a bar (BarContainer) and its sections (WidgetGroup).
- `BarShapes.qml`: The shapes bar widget backgrounds take (Bars[].widgetShape, a slanted or arrow widget's or run's ends by Bars[].widgetEnds), alone or in runs (Bars[].widgetGrouping): which cap each end of a widget gets, how much room i…
- `BarWidgetStyle.qml`: What a bar widget draws in, by its bar's widget style: { fill, stroke, indicator, text, icon }.
- `BindActions.qml`: What each keybind action (the schema's Keybinds.binds[].action) is, independent of the compositor: its IPC call into axiom, default label, section on the Keybinds page, calls, starting flags and whether it takes an argu…
- `BindGroups.qml`: The Keybinds editor's list: axiom's binds grouped by section, and in a section, numbered runs (SUPER + 1 … SUPER + 0 going to workspaces 1–10) folded into one row.
- `BindKeys.qml`: Binds against what the compositor reports (CompositorManager.withBinds entries: { modmask, key, keycode, description, submap }, the modifiers as X11 mask bits, as Hyprland's `hyprctl binds -j` lists them and SwayConf re…
- `BindRows.qml`: The Keybinds reference's rows (KeybindManager.keybindings): numbered runs and direction sets folded into one row each, and a section's rows grouped by their modifiers.
- `CalendarEvents.qml`: Pure helpers for calendar events (see CalendarManager): day keys, which days an event covers, a day's events in order, dots, what's next, reminders due, editing drafts and the launcher's quick add.
- `ChatMarkdown.qml`: Splits a chat reply into what the chat draws separately: Markdown prose (a TextEdit in MarkdownText) and fenced code blocks (a box of their own, with a copy button).
- `ChatProtocol.qml`: The chat providers' wire formats, as pure functions: ChatManager builds a request with request(), ChatRequest sends it with curl and feeds every streamed event to parse().
- `ColorTemperature.qml`: The color of light at a temperature in Kelvin (Tanner Helland's fit to blackbody colors), for showing what a night light setting looks like.
- `ColumnSplit.qml`: Splits an ordered list of cards into two newspaper columns (the first k on the left, the rest on the right) so both end as close together as they can, from the cards' heights.
- `CommunityCatalog.qml`: The community setups catalog (github.com/axiom-shell/community-setups, its `catalog` branch): reading its index.json, searching it, and where each file comes from and goes.
- `CompositorKind.qml`: Which compositor axiom runs under, from the environment (CompositorManager.kind).
- `CompositorLayer.qml`: What axiom asks of the compositor, decided once in a neutral shape: the window look and the input that are on, which the shell sends the daemon's config layer (CompositorConfigManager.spec; the daemon's port of the rest…
- `DataDirs.qml`: Where axiom keeps what it writes (XDG base directories).
- `DockLayout.qml`: Pure helpers for the dock: which apps it shows (pinned ones, then running ones), which window a click goes to, how big each icon is under the pointer, and whether a window covers it.
- `DynamicWorkspaces.qml`: niri's workspaces for a compositor that only has ids (Hyprland, under the scrolling layout): each output's workspaces are its block's ids from the first, without gaps, with one empty one after the last.
- `EdgeAttach.qml`: Where a box that grows out of a screen edge goes along it: bar popouts, edge popouts (the launcher, OSDs, floating edge menus) and anything else drawn with AttachedSurface.
- `GreeterBundle.qml`: The greeter's config, exported: GreeterManager writes it, `axiom greeter` loads it for the greeter (falling back to the install's snapshot, then the defaults).
- `GreeterSessions.qml`: The sessions the greeter can start (GreetdManager): Wayland session desktop entries (wayland-sessions/*.desktop in each data dir), their Exec line split into the argv greetd launches, and the environment they start in.
- `GreeterUsers.qml`: The people the greeter offers to log in (GreetdManager): accounts from /etc/passwd whose uid is in /etc/login.defs' UID_MIN..UID_MAX (regular users, not system accounts) and whose shell lets them log in.
- `GridPlacement.qml`: Pure geometry of the module grid shared by overlay pages, edge menus and the layouts editor.
- `HyprLua.qml`: Hyprland's Lua from schema fields, for what the shell sends Hyprland itself (the layer rules, monitor calls, the greeter's config; axiom's config layer is the daemon's: internal/compositor/render): each field with x-com…
- `HyprReply.qml`: Requests and replies on Hyprland's request socket (HyprlandIpcManager), which answers one request per connection, in hyprctl's wire format: "j/" asks for JSON, "[[BATCH]]a;b" runs several and joins their replies with bl…
- `HyprState.qml`: Hyprland's JSON replies (HyprlandManager) as the shapes the rest of the shell reads, which don't depend on the compositor: what another compositor's service would hand back too.
- `HypridleConf.qml`: The hypridle config axiom runs hypridle with (HypridleManager), from the Idle section: a general block, then one listener per step whose timeout isn't 0 (dim, lock, screen off, suspend) in timeout order, then the user's…
- `IconResolver.qml`: Resolves icon names for window classes: desktop entries first, then known substitutions, then name variants that exist in the icon theme.
- `JsonRpc.qml`: JSON-RPC 2.0, one message per line (NDJSON): how the shell talks to the axiom binary (BackendManager; docs/dev/backend/README.md).
- `KeyMap.qml`: The Keybinds editor's key map: a US keyboard as rows of keys (by the names binds use, KeyNames), and which of them a set of modifiers leaves free, given axiom's binds and the user's own.
- `KeyNames.qml`: Keys as Hyprland writes them ("SUPER + SHIFT + space"): turning a Qt key event into one (for recording a bind), and splitting one for display.
- `KeybindFilter.qml`: The Keybinds page's filter over KeybindManager.keybindings: a search plus toggle chips in three groups (sections, modifiers, source).
- `KeyboardLayouts.qml`: A keyboard's layouts as the shell shows them ({ layouts, index, keymap }, CompositorManager.withKeyboard), from the full names a compositor reports ("English (US)"): the same for every backend that only has those.
- `LayerArrange.qml`: Where a compositor puts layer-shell surfaces on an output (pure): the wlr-layer-shell arrangement that sway, niri and Hyprland share (docs/dev/compositor/layer-arrangement.md).
- `LayerStack.qml`: The order axiom's layer surfaces stack and reserve their space in, on every compositor (pure).
- `LibraryOrder.qml`: How the editors' libraries (bar widgets, overlay modules) order their types: by label, or by group (the schema's `x-libraryGroups`, in order) and by label within each.
- `MonitorLayout.qml`: Pure helpers for the Monitors page (MonitorManager): modes, scales, rotation, the layout's rects and snapping, and picking the profile for the connected outputs.
- `NiriConf.qml`: niri's IPC requests the shell sends niri itself (NiriManager): monitor rules set now (docs/dev/compositor/niri-backend.md). axiom's config layer is the daemon's (internal/compositor/render).
- `NiriState.qml`: niri's IPC replies and events (NiriManager) as the shapes the rest of the shell reads, which don't depend on the compositor (docs/dev/compositor/contract.md), as SwayState is for sway. niri's state is kept as its own ob…
- `NoteMarkdown.qml`: A note's Markdown as blocks for the notes editor (content/parts/notes/ NoteEditor): paragraphs of plain lines (split at blank lines, which stay with the paragraph above; a code fence is never split, and holds no tasks),…
- `Packages.qml`: Which distribution this is (from its os-release) and what installs a command there: each command's package per distribution, the shell lines that install a set of them (install hints), and how it checks for and installs…
- `PolkitAgents.qml`: The polkit agents axiom knows about (PolkitManager): a session has one agent, so while axiom is its agent these are stopped and left out of the generated autostart.
- `PomodoroCycle.qml`: The pomodoro timer's rules, for PomodoroManager.
- `PopoutGeometry.qml`: Which popouts give way to which (PopoutManager): every popout reports its footprint (rects in screen px, from SurfaceOutline.footprint, fillets included), and one opening closes only what it actually covers, by rank.
- `Schedules.qml`: Pure helpers for what changes on its own: daily time windows ("HH:MM", 24-hour; the light/dark schedule, night light) and picking the next wallpaper of a rotation.
- `SchemaLayout.qml`: Turns the config schema into the settings page's layout: categories (`x-category` on each top-level section, ordered by the root's `x-categories`), each made of groups (the section's own fields, then one per nested obje…
- `SchemaValidation.qml`: JSON-schema helpers for the config: validation and filling in defaults (pruning and loading are the axiom binary's).
- `Search.qml`: Pure helpers for searching lists by typed text: the launcher's fuzzy score, frecency from a { count, last } use record (Utils.recordUse) and whether text reads as math for the calculator.
- `ShownLook.qml`: What the look shows at the moment, from what the user chose (config) and what changes on its own (runtime state ThemeManager keeps: the rotation's wallpapers, the theme schedule's variant).
- `StopwatchClock.qml`: The one-off timer's and the stopwatch's rules, for StopwatchManager.
- `SurfaceContext.qml`: What a surface growing out of a screen edge touches, and every rule that follows from it, for each kind of surface alike: bar popouts, edge popouts (OSDs, floating edge menus, the attached launcher), docks and submenus.
- `SurfaceOutline.qml`: The outline of a surface that grows out of an edge (AttachedSurface): a content box joined to the attach edge by two concave fillets, or a plain box held off it.
- `SwayConf.qml`: Sway commands the shell sends sway itself (SwayManager): output commands and the greeter's input (docs/dev/compositor/sway-backend.md). axiom's config layer is the daemon's (internal/compositor/render).
- `SwayState.qml`: Sway's IPC replies (SwayManager) as the shapes the rest of the shell reads, which don't depend on the compositor (docs/dev/compositor/contract.md), as HyprState is for Hyprland.
- `ThemeFamilies.qml`: Groups themes into the families the theme list shows (a dark/light pair is one theme) and finds the family a theme name belongs to, for ThemeManager.
- `TimeZones.qml`: Pure helpers for clocks in another time zone.
- `TodoItems.qml`: The todo list's items and every change to them, for TodoManager: each returns a new list and leaves its input alone.
- `Utils.qml`: Pure helpers: deep copies and comparison, free ids, usage counts, curl config values, text width and truncation, colors, calendar grids, byte sizes and rates.
- `WindowOrder.qml`: Windows in the order they were used (the window switcher): the compositor's windows by focusRank, and stepping through them.
- `WorkspaceGeometry.qml`: Pure geometry for the workspace overview: a cols×rows board of monitor miniatures.

## components/reusable/

- `ActionPill.qml`: A wide action or toggle tile, as in Android's quick settings: an icon well beside a name and a status line.
- `ActionTile.qml`: An action or toggle tile: an icon well over a label.
- `AddEntryButton.qml`: An outlined full-width button under a list that adds to it ("New bar", "New page")
- `BackdropRequest.qml`: A full-screen surface's dim background on its screen, shown while `shown`: drawn by that screen's backdrop window (ScreenBackdrop, through BackdropManager), under the bars and the border.
- `BaseWidget.qml`: Rounded background box for bar modules.
- `BlurRegion.qml`: A window's blur region (BackgroundEffect.blurRegion, where the compositor blurs only what a window asks: supports.blurRegion), from `pieces` in the window's coordinates (SurfaceOutline.blurRegion, placed by placeRegion)…
- `BoxBlurRegion.qml`: One box as a blur region (BackgroundEffect.blurRegion, where the compositor blurs only what a window asks: supports.blurRegion), in its window's coordinates, its corners rounded as the box's (a Rectangle's `radius`; set…
- `CodeLine.qml`: Text to paste somewhere (a config line, a command), in a monospace box with a Copy button
- `ColorGlide.qml`: The shell's eased change to a color: `ColorGlide on color {}` is `Behavior on color { ColorAnimation { duration: Appearance.animFast; easing.type: Appearance.easing } }`.
- `CornerPiece.qml`: Concave "inverted corner" piece: fills the corner (isLeft/isTop) of its box with fillColor up to a quarter-circle, and strokes the two box edges leading away from that corner joined by the arc.
- `CountBadge.qml`: A small pill holding a count (or any short label), for a button's or an icon's corner: StyledRectButton's badge, the notification bell's.
- `CrossFade.qml`: Shows `value` through `delegate`, cross-fading when it changes: a new copy is made for the new value and fades in over the old one, which fades out and goes.
- `DragArea.qml`: A MouseArea that tells a press-and-move drag from a click: past `threshold` pixels it's a drag (dragStarted at the press point, then dragMoved), released it's dropped; a press that didn't move is tapped.
- `DragChip.qml`: A pill with an icon and a name that can be carried: a bar widget or a module type in the editors.
- `DragLayer.qml`: An editor area that carries one drag at a time over its content (`content`, the default property): the bar editor's (BarDragLayer) and the layouts editor's (GridDragLayer).
- `DropdownSurface.qml`: The box of something that drops down over other content (a picker, a list opened from a header): bordered, rounded, with a shadow while `floating`
- `FieldGroup.qml`: A titled group of fields, as on the settings page (editor inspectors)
- `FlashOutline.qml`: An accent outline over what it fills that shows for a moment on flash(): what a jump to a settings card or row lands on.
- `FlatIconButton.qml`: A flat icon button (no fill until hovered) of a fixed square size that doesn't stretch in layouts, so every button in a row shares one size and centre line (the chat's and notes' toolbars)
- `FoldHeader.qml`: A fold's clickable header (FoldingCard, FoldingSection): a SectionHeading with its description only while unfolded, an optional line above it, the unsaved-edits dot while folded with `marked`, and a chevron.
- `FoldingColumn.qml`: A column that folds open and shut: its height runs between its content's and nothing, clipped on the way, its content fading with it, and it hides once shut.
- `FoldingSection.qml`: A FoldHeader over a FoldingColumn: clicking the heading emits `toggled`, and the body folds shut while `collapsed`.
- `FrameNudge.qml`: An invisible pixel that flips for a few frames after burst(), so its window draws (and commits) again and the last frame shown is the right one.
- `Glide.qml`: The shell's eased change to a number: `Glide on width {}` is `Behavior on width { NumberAnimation { duration: Appearance.animFast; easing.type: Appearance.easing } }`.
- `HoledItem.qml`: Draws its children with `holes` (rects in its coordinates) cut out: a stroke left open where something joined to it carries on over it.
- `IconTextWidget.qml`: An icon followed by a label, laid along the bar's main axis (the label is rotated on a vertical bar).
- `InspectorHeader.qml`: The top of an editor's inspector (bar widget, overlay module or cell): the thing's icon in a well (accent-filled when `filled`), its name and where it is, then its actions (children), over a faint divider
- `IssueList.qml`: Problems found in an editor's draft, one per line: an icon and the text, red for errors, amber for warnings and accent for info.
- `KeyHint.qml`: A key in a controls hint: a keycap and what it does, e.g. [↵] open
- `KeyedLoader.qml`: Builds `sourceComponent` anew whenever `key` changes, and nothing while it's empty.
- `LastFound.qml`: The last non-null `source`: an entry looked up by id (a dock, an OSD) reads null for a moment as it's removed, before what's built from it is destroyed, which would otherwise be handed null.
- `ListEntryRow.qml`: One entry of an editor's list (bars, overlay pages, edge menus): an icon and a name, filled with the accent while selected, then `badges`, the unsaved-edits dot and the row's actions (RowActions, as children).
- `PasswordEntry.qml`: A password field with what an authenticator shows under it: a message, a sliding bar while it checks, and a shake when it fails.
- `PercentageCircle.qml`: A ring gauge: a thin track with a round-capped arc over it, like a StyledSlider bent into a circle, and an icon in the middle
- `PipewireVolumeBar.qml`: A StyledVolumeBar bound to a Pipewire stream (by app name) or the system volume: shows and sets its level and mute; the OSD's audio bars.
- `PopInRectangle.qml`: A small mark that pops in and out (CountBadge, StatusChip, UnsavedDot): set `shown` rather than `visible`, and it grows in from its centre and shrinks away, staying visible (and laid out) until it has.
- `RowAction.qml`: A small flat button on a ListEntryRow, faint until the row is hovered or selected.
- `ScrollMemory.qml`: Keeps where a Flickable was scrolled to (EditsManager, by `key`), so a panel rebuilt when the overlay reopens comes back to the same spot.
- `SectionHeading.qml`: A section's title in the accent, with an optional muted description under it (FieldGroup, the theme list)
- `SegmentButton.qml`: One button of a segmented choice (Dark/Light, a wallpaper mode): the chosen one is filled with the accent; one that can't be chosen is dimmed.
- `SegmentRow.qml`: A single choice as one control: SegmentButtons on a shared track, with the chosen one's accent sliding from button to button.
- `SquareIconButton.qml`: A StyledRectButton that fills with the accent on hover and dims when disabled
- `StatusChip.qml`: A small filled pill with a bold word: a status (On, Running, Not installed) in its colour, on the settings page's status cards
- `StreamedLoader.qml`: A Loader built a moment after it's created, from BuildQueueManager's queue, then faded in: a tool page's sections, cards and long lists, so the page shows at once and fills in over the next frames instead of building ev…
- `StyledComboEntry.qml`: A choice from a list that drops down under the field, optionally typed (`editable`): typing filters the list and Enter takes what was typed, or the highlighted match.
- `StyledContainer.qml`: A themed box: background through the surface opacity (or solid), optional border and radius.
- `StyledIcon.qml`: A Material Symbols icon: `text` is its name ("wifi"), or several names separated by spaces or newlines.
- `StyledIconButton.qml`: A ToolButton showing a Material Symbols icon, with hover and press colors and an optional tooltip.
- `StyledRectButton.qml`: A rectangular icon button with hover and press colors, a tooltip and an optional count badge.
- `StyledScrollView.qml`: A ScrollView with the shell's padding and a thin accent scroll bar that shows only when asked.
- `StyledSeparator.qml`: A divider line, `separatorHeight` thick (the border width), in the border color unless set
- `StyledSlider.qml`: A themed slider (trough, fill, handle) that emits moved while dragged and released at the end; a value pushed in animates to it.
- `StyledSwitch.qml`: A themed on/off switch.
- `StyledTabBar.qml`: A row of equal-width tabs (StyledTabButtons), one per label in `tabs`.
- `StyledTabButton.qml`: One tab of a StyledTabBar: only its label, the bar drawing the current tab's highlight, which slides between its tabs
- `StyledText.qml`: Text in the shell's font, size and foreground color; optionally turned for a vertical bar.
- `StyledTextArea.qml`: A multi-line text field in a StyledContainer, optionally growing with its text.
- `StyledTextButton.qml`: A button with a text label and an optional Material Symbols icon, with hover and press colors and an optional tooltip.
- `StyledTextEntry.qml`: A single-line text field in a StyledContainer.
- `StyledToolTip.qml`: Hover tooltip in a popup window of its own, so it isn't clipped by the small layer windows (bars, popouts) buttons live in.
- `StyledVolumeBar.qml`: A volume bar (vertical or horizontal) with its icon, mute and optional percentage: drag, click or scroll to set it.
- `SurfaceGroup.qml`: Keeps a surface's instances on every monitor in step when its `monitors` mode is "all": opening or closing one opens or closes the rest (`syncRequested`).
- `TileFlow.qml`: A Flow of equal tiles: as many columns of at least `minTileWidth` as fit (never fewer than `minColumns`); tiles take `tileWidth`
- `TrashTarget.qml`: A trash can that appears while an editor carries something it can delete: dropped on it, the drag layer removes what's carried (`targetKind` "trash"; the layer's `accepts` decides what it takes and its `dropped` does th…
- `TypeLibrary.qml`: A library of types to add (the bar editor's widgets, the layouts editor's modules): an A–Z / By category switch over equal tiles, one `delegate` per type (given `modelData`; tiles take `tileWidth`), by label or under a …
- `TypePickerPopup.qml`: i18n: keys from callers and the schema (titles, descriptions, type labels) Shared "pick a type to add" popup (bar widgets, overlay views, ...), with a search field: typing filters by label or type, Up/Down move, Enter p…
- `UnsavedDot.qml`: The dot beside something with unsaved edits (a settings category, card or field; a bar, page or edge menu in its editor).

## components/surfaces/backdrop/

- `ScreenBackdrop.qml`: A screen's dim background for full-screen surfaces (the overlay, workspace overview, launcher, power menu, onboarding; BackdropRequest): the whole monitor, under the bars and the border, which stay drawn over it.

## components/surfaces/border/

- `BorderPanel.qml`: One edge of the screen border (RoundedBorders): a strip that reserves `frameWidth` and draws the frame with its inner stroke, which stops short of the corners by `innerBorderRadius` where the corner pieces take over.
- `RoundedBorders.qml`: One screen's border (Appearance.screenBorder): an edge strip per side (BorderPanel), reserving `frameWidth`, and a concave corner piece (CornerPiece) in each corner joining their inner strokes.

## components/surfaces/desktop/

- `DesktopWindow.qml`: A screen's desktop modules (a DesktopLayout, DesktopConfig.layoutFor), under the windows: on the Bottom layer, over the wallpaper.

## components/surfaces/dock/

- `DockItem.qml`: One app on a dock: its icon (grown by the dock's magnification) and a running indicator, spanning the whole depth of the dock window at its place along it (DockWindow.starts/sizes).
- `DockMenu.qml`: A dock app's menu, opening towards the screen from its icon: its name and windows (click one to focus it), and, opened by a right click (`full`), Keep in dock / Remove from dock, New window and Close.
- `DockMenuRow.qml`: A clickable row in a dock app's menu: an icon and a label
- `DockWindow.qml`: One dock (a DockEntry) on one screen: a strip along its edge, inside the bars and border, holding a box of app icons.

## components/surfaces/edgemenu/

- `EdgeMenu.qml`: One edge menu from EdgeMenusConfig, on its screen, in its mode.
- `EdgeMenuBody.qml`: An edge menu's modules on a grid of quarter cards, as on a Custom overlay page, with its screen's overlay cards (EdgeMenuManager.cardUnitOf).
- `EdgeMenuSync.qml`: What both edge menu hosts (FloatingEdgeMenu, IntegratedEdgeMenu) share: following EdgeMenuManager (opening and closing when it says, telling it when the menu closes by itself), being held open (pinned, or by the editor)…
- `FloatingEdgeMenu.qml`: A floating edge menu: an EdgePopout over the windows, growing out of the border or a solid bar on its edge, and meeting any other bar there as a bar popout does (EdgePlacement): out of a pill or a floating bar's island,…
- `IntegratedEdgeMenu.qml`: An integrated edge menu: a Top-layer strip along the whole edge whose exclusive zone is arranged before everything else's (the axiom-edge-menu layer rule, HyprlandManager._addLayerRules), so it sits outermost and the bo…

## components/surfaces/greeter/

- `GreeterPreviewWindow.qml`: The layouts editor's "Show on screen" for the login screen: its draft (GreeterManager.editor.localLayout) on the target screen, in a plain Overlay-layer window.
- `GreeterSurface.qml`: What one screen of the greeter shows (greetd's login screen, run from greeter.qml), or the layouts editor's preview of it: the layout's background and modules (ScreenLayoutView).
- `GreeterWindow.qml`: The greeter on one screen (shell/Greeter): a full-screen Overlay-layer window, the only thing greetd's Hyprland shows.

## components/surfaces/launcher/

- `Launcher.qml`: The search launcher on one screen.
- `LauncherPanel.qml`: The launcher's contents: the search field, the results and the controls hint, without a box of its own: its host's surface is the box (a FloatingPopout, or on a screen edge an EdgePopout).
- `LauncherRow.qml`: One launcher result (a LauncherManager row): an icon or glyph, the title (with a command's usage after it), a description line and a hint chip.

## components/surfaces/lockscreen/

- `LockPreviewWindow.qml`: The layouts editor's "Show on screen": the lock screen draft (LockManager.editor.localLayout) on the target screen, in a plain Overlay-layer window.
- `LockSurface.qml`: What one screen shows while the built-in lock is up (the content of a WlSessionLockSurface, see shell/Lockscreen.qml), or in the layouts editor's preview: the layout's background and modules (ScreenLayoutView).

## components/surfaces/monitors/

- `MonitorPromptWindow.qml`: One screen's prompt: its name while MonitorManager identifies, and Keep / Revert with the countdown while an applied layout waits

## components/surfaces/notifications/

- `NotificationToast.qml`: One notification's toast, anchored to a screen corner by shell/Notifications: times out, swipes away, and runs the notification's actions.

## components/surfaces/onboarding/

- `OnboardingWindow.qml`: The onboarder (OnboardingManager): one page at a time over the dimmed screen, with the step bar where the overlay has its page navigator.
- `StepBar.qml`: The onboarder's steps where the overlay has its page navigator (the same navigator, so the pages get the overlay's room): Skip setup, the steps, and Next (Finish on the last).

- `MonitorsPage.qml`: saying what to do with it

- `OnboardingPage.qml`: One onboarding page: a titled card as wide as the Monitors page and two cards high, sized from the overlay's grid, with a short introduction over the page's own content (its children).

- `WelcomePage.qml`: First page: what axiom is, language and name, and the overlay's size (this window is sized as the overlay is, so it's the preview)
- `WorkspacesPage.qml`: How workspaces are laid out (the Workspaces section), with a small picture of two monitors in the chosen layout, then whether windows tile or sit on strips (Workspaces.strips: every monitor here, one by one in the list …

## components/surfaces/osd/

## components/surfaces/polkit/

## components/surfaces/powermenu/

- `PowerMenuTile.qml`: One power menu action.
- `PowerMenuWindow.qml`: The power menu on one screen: a card with a greeting and the uptime, a row of session actions and a controls hint, over the dim backdrop.

## components/surfaces/screenlayout/

- `ScreenLayoutView.qml`: One screen of a screen layout (a ScreenLayout: the lock screen's, the greeter's; or a DesktopLayout): the background (wallpaper or a color, dimmed), then the modules on as many units as fit the screen inside `insets` at…

## components/surfaces/screenshot/

## components/surfaces/switcher/

- `SwitcherKeys.qml`: The window switcher's keys where the compositor can't report their release (no supports.switcherRelease: sway fires a release bind only when no other key came between).

- `WorkspaceNumber.qml`: A workspace's number badge on the overview board, drawn over its windows
